§6Purpose and mechanism§r
Keep a Gear Steam Compressor controller in your inventory to complete this item check; the items are not consumed. The compressor converts regular steam into a smaller amount of superheated steam and distilled water, so it requires a steady steam supply.

§3Preparation and operation§r
Once you have the controller, plan where conversion belongs in the supply network: ordinary steam at the inlet, with separate superheated-steam and distilled-water outlets. This inventory check does not require a structure or an operating conversion line. For production, use the tier documentation to check throughput and byproduct handling; collecting the controller is not an operational acceptance test.
